records.Concise description: A launch-era fair-mint meme Rune built around a satirical Casey Rodarmor story and etched ten blocks after Runes activation.
records.Deeper researched summary: WANKO•MANKO•RUNES is a Day-1-era community Rune whose official site describes it as a 0%-premine, community-run meme project inspired by a satirical story written by Runes creator Casey Rodarmor. Current on-chain/indexed state identifies Rune ID `840010:4` (Rune #899), a zero premine, and a finite open mint that closed shortly after launch with 75.25 million units created. The completed launch phase is historically significant, but current meaningful project/community operation was not verified strongly enough for ACTIVE status.
Creators / founders: Community-run project; Casey Rodarmor — author of the underlying satirical story, not established here as Rune project operator
records.Launch / history: Etched at block 840,010 shortly after activation. Its open mint ran for a short launch window and closed below the maximum cap.
records.Why it matters in the Runes ecosystem: It captures the immediate meme/community experimentation that followed the technical Runes launch and has direct cultural proximity to the protocol creator’s writing.
Important technical or cultural characte: 75.25 million indexed supply from a completed open mint
records.Verification basis: Official project pages establish the stated cultural origin and fair-mint framing; ordinals.com verifies the Rune’s protocol fields and completed mint.
Research notes / uncertainties: Website availability alone is not sufficient to establish current ACTIVE project operation, so lifecycle is HISTORICAL.
The linked satirical story contains explicit adult material; future MSC public copy should mention the cultural origin without reproducing explicit content unless editorially necessary.
Do not describe Casey Rodarmor as the Rune project operator without direct evidence.

records.Concise description: A fair-minted cat-themed Rune project with a current community site and companion tools, launched in May 2024 with no premine.
records.Deeper researched summary: BILLION•DOLLAR•CAT (Billy) is a community Rune whose official site states that the mint completed in roughly 18 hours on May 30, 2024 with a 0% premine. The current project ecosystem includes BillyBot and other community tools. Runes-aware indexers agree on Rune ID `845764:84` and a one-billion-unit launch structure, but current indexer displays disagree on the Rune number and some supply/mint fields. MSC therefore treats the Rune ID and official launch account as the more stable publication basis.
Creators / founders: Billion Dollar Cat community / project operators — individual founder attribution not locked
records.Launch / history: Launched as a zero-premine open mint on May 30, 2024. The project later developed community tooling and continues to maintain an official site.
records.Why it matters in the Runes ecosystem: It is a durable post-launch community Rune example with a verifiable fair-mint history and ongoing project tooling, while also illustrating why indexer-derived numeric state sometimes needs reconciliation.
Important technical or cultural characte: One billion-unit launch structure reported by project/indexer sources
Indexer disagreement on Rune number/current display fields
records.Verification basis: Current first-party project site supports launch model and current operation. Two Runes-aware indexers support the Rune ID but expose a material metadata/state-display discrepancy.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not publish a timeless Rune number or current supply/mint count without reconciling the RuneMine and Ordiscan discrepancy.
Use Rune ID `845764:84` as the stable identifier in public technical copy unless fresh primary/on-chain verification resolves the number discrepancy.

records.Concise description: A later-era community Rune with active 2026 social/brand activity and Rune ID `865286:2249`.
records.Deeper researched summary: WISHY•WASHY•MACHINE is a community/brand Rune etched in October 2024. Runes-aware index data identifies ID `865286:2249`, a 500-million-unit supply structure built from 50,000 mints of 10,000 units, and symbol `💦`. Current project social activity continues through 2026 and points to a dedicated project domain and merchandise presence. Because current activity is visible but some evidence was captured through third-party social mirroring/indexing rather than directly archived first-party pages, source confidence is MEDIUM.
Creators / founders: Zach (@Zachkag) — identified as a co-founder in current project social material; additional team attribution not locked
records.Launch / history: Etched at block 865,286 in October 2024. The project developed an active social/community brand and remains visibly active in 2026.
records.Why it matters in the Runes ecosystem: It broadens the Runes canon beyond launch-block assets by representing a later community project with sustained identity and operation rather than short-lived market volume alone.
records.Verification basis: Current project social/brand activity supports ACTIVE lifecycle; Runes-aware index data supports numeric fields. Direct capture of all first-party pages was incomplete, so confidence remains MEDIUM.
Research notes / uncertainties: The project domain association is supported by project social material; direct site content should be re-captured before unqualified publication.
Only Zach is identified as a co-founder in the captured evidence; do not infer the full team.
Numeric Rune state should be reverified against a primary/second indexer before public technical copy.

records.Concise description: A zero-premine October 2024 community Rune with a completed one-billion-unit mint and an originally documented viral/public-license framing.
records.Deeper researched summary: GIZMO•IMAGINARY•KITTEN was etched at block 865,193 with Rune ID `865193:4006`. Current ordinals.com state shows a completed zero-premine open mint of one billion units, divisibility 8, and symbol `😺`. Launch-era exchange/reporting sources identified it as a community Rune under a Viral Public License and linked a project site/social presence. The former project domain is now lapsed/for sale, and current operator/community activity could not be verified strongly enough, so lifecycle remains UNCERTAIN rather than being inferred from continued trading.
Creators / founders: Community-launched project; individual creator/operator attribution not sufficiently verified
records.Launch / history: Etched in October 2024 with a zero-premine open mint that reached its full one-billion-unit supply. Launch-era sources documented a dedicated site and social channels.
records.Why it matters in the Runes ecosystem: It is a later fair-mint community example with a verifiable zero-premine launch, while its lapsed web presence makes it a useful case for separating lifecycle uncertainty from on-chain persistence.
Important technical or cultural characte: One billion units from 100,000 mints of 10,000
Former dedicated site is no longer an active project destination
records.Verification basis: On-chain/indexed Rune state verifies launch mechanics. Launch-era third-party sources establish historical project framing, but the former official domain is lapsed and current project operation was not verified.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not use the lapsed `gizmokitten.xyz` domain as a current Official website.
Historical social/site links should not be treated as proof of current control.
Lifecycle remains UNCERTAIN; marketplace activity alone cannot establish ACTIVE status.

records.Concise description: A 2024 hamster-themed community Rune with identifier `846400:165` and a reported 21-million-unit supply.
records.Deeper researched summary: SAIKO•HAMSTER is a post-launch community Rune identified by multiple Runes-aware/independent sources as Rune ID `846400:165`, with a 21-million-unit supply. Historical/current directory sources point to `saikohamster.com` and an associated social presence, but the website was unavailable during this verification pass and independent uptime evidence indicates it has been offline. Because current project operation could not be verified from strong first-party evidence, lifecycle is UNCERTAIN even though the asset remains indexed and traded.
records.Launch / history: Etched in the post-launch 2024 Runes ecosystem. Project directories and exchange material associate it with a dedicated Saiko Hamster site/social identity.
records.Why it matters in the Runes ecosystem: It represents a later community Rune that achieved enough identifiable project presence to merit research coverage, while its current lifecycle cannot be responsibly inferred from market listings.
Important technical or cultural characte: 21 million-unit supply reported across supporting sources
records.Verification basis: Multiple independent/indexer sources agree on the Rune identity and historical project site, but current first-party operation was not captured and the site is unavailable.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not publish an ACTIVE project claim based on exchange/market presence.
Official website is left null because the dedicated site was unavailable during verification.
Utility/governance claims from exchange descriptions are not treated as verified project facts.

records.Concise description: Liquidium’s official Rune for governance and utility around its Bitcoin-native lending application and related protocol ecosystem.
records.Deeper researched summary: LIQUIDIUM•TOKEN (LIQ) is the official Rune associated with Liquidium, a Bitcoin L1 lending application. Current Liquidium materials describe LIQ as a governance/utility asset, publish tokenomics and a genesis-airdrop program, and operate a governance forum with current proposals. On-chain/indexed state identifies the canonical Rune as #929 / ID `840010:907`, with a 100-million-unit full premine and divisibility 2. Later child assets such as STAKED•LIQUIDIUM are modeled as related protocol assets rather than separate canonical profiles in this initial MSC Runes canon.
Creators / founders: Liquidium team / Liquidium Foundation — project operators; individual founder attribution not required for this registry
records.Launch / history: Etched shortly after Runes activation. Liquidium distributed part of the supply through a genesis airdrop tied to early users and selected communities, then expanded LIQ into governance/staking-related application functions.
records.Why it matters in the Runes ecosystem: It is a strong example of a Rune used by an active Bitcoin application rather than primarily as a meme or collectible-community asset.
Important technical or cultural characte: Genesis airdrop to early users/selected communities
Current governance forum and protocol operation
records.Verification basis: Current first-party product, tokenomics, airdrop, governance, and staking materials establish the canonical project relationship and active lifecycle; ordinals.com supports Rune state.
Research notes / uncertainties: STAKED•LIQUIDIUM is modeled as a child/related protocol asset, not a separate initial canonical Rune profile.
Token utility/governance mechanics are implementation/project behavior and should not be described as Bitcoin consensus rules.
Any current staking/yield mechanics are time-sensitive and require fresh verification before operational public guidance.
